items.claim: Billy Goff possesses a higher level of experience with more UFC appearances than Tai Miller.
items.quote: Billy is a little bit more proven as in like he's had way more UFC fights. I think he's this will be his fifth where this is Tai's second.

items.claim: Billy Goff has faced a higher level of competition overall compared to Tai Miller.
items.quote: He's also had more fights overall and he's fought better level of competition.

items.claim: Billy Goff is extremely tough and likely to survive to a decision despite getting hurt.
items.quote: I lean decision because I think Goff is just so tough, but I do think that he will also probably get hurt in this fight.
